status: frozen before any Gate A or Gate B main run; never changed after a main run starts (a change needs a new version and a new hidden split)
claim_rule: A level is claimed only on 3 seeds, hidden evaluation data, and a clean commit.

L1.name: Compressor-grade
L1.bpb_rule: held-out real-text BPB at or below min(PPM-C order 5, Kneser-Ney order 5) re-measured on the same stream at equal exposure bytes
L1.reference_note: Measured 2026-11-26 (docs/data.md). The rule re-measures the baselines at claim time; these values only show where the bar sits today. With 33 books the hidden role is a few books, so differences under about 0.05 BPB are not reliable.

L2.name: Fluent
L2.blind_rating: blind raters judge generated sentences locally grammatical
pending: the Wikipedia corpus is not in the manifest yet; the BPB threshold applies once a licensed Wikipedia held-out role exists

L3.name: Small LLM (1.0 target)
L3.blind_rating: coherent multi-sentence generation under blind rating

L4.name: Assistant
L4.requires: L3 plus instruction following and multi-turn dialogue on hidden human-written prompts, with calibrated abstention; thresholds frozen in the generation milestone

source_check.method: Numbers read from the published pages by a fetch agent (second-hand, not from the PDFs, whose text could not be extracted). Not independently re-read by hand.
source_check.blimp: BLiMP paper (Warstadt et al. 2020), main results table via ar5iv: overall accuracy 5-gram 61.2, LSTM 69.8, Transformer-XL 69.6, GPT-2 83.0, human 88.6. The L2 bar (0.75) sits below GPT-2 and the L3 bar (0.80) below it, both under the human figure; consistent with the roadmap's intent. The repository's note that some published table entries were mis-reported was not checked.
source_check.gpt2: OpenAI's GPT-2 release page (zero-shot table, the largest model): LAMBADA accuracy 63.24%, perplexity 8.6; enwik8 0.93 and text8 0.98 bits per character; WikiText-103 perplexity 17.48. The 117M-model rows of the paper's Table 3 could not be read, so the L3 LAMBADA bar (0.35) is not checked against the small model's published value.
source_check.bpb_caveat: The BPB bars (1.5 and 1.2) are for held-out Wikipedia text under this project's byte model. enwik8 and text8 numbers are for other corpora and preprocessing, so they bracket the scale only; they do not check the bars. The bars become measurable once the Simple English Wikipedia held-out role exists and are then compared with the Kneser-Ney order-5 baseline on it.

source_check_open: Open: read Table 3 of the GPT-2 paper for the 117M rows; compare the BPB bars with measured baselines on the Wikipedia held-out role.
